decisions.reason: Always-on testing.md mandates 'MANDATORY workflow: 1. Write test first' and a flat 80% coverage for every module; the project makes test-first conditional and sets 75% overall / 80% only for scoring/ and review/. ~11.1k chars loaded in every session.

SKILL.md says 'ALWAYS write tests first' and 'Minimum 80% coverage (unit + integration + E2E)'; the project makes test-first conditional and E2E only if a web app is chosen. Examples are jest/npm while the stack is pytest.
AGENTS.md per-task procedure already requires running make lint test before ticking the task; the skill's commands are npm/console.log oriented.
Planning is already done: 14 spec files plus a phased task checklist the agent must follow one task at a time.

covered_by.quote: Python 3.12, type hints đầy đủ, `ruff` + `mypy --strict` pass.

decisions.reason: Only rejected because it conflicts with ecc.rules.common. The project states its own standard (Python 3.12, full type hints, ruff + mypy --strict).
No ground to skip and no concrete gap either: there is no code yet, so nothing to debug. Reasonable to defer until Phase 1 code exists.

decisions.gap: No reviewer subagent and no code-review step in the AGENTS.md task procedure (spec -> test -> implement -> make lint test -> tick -> PROGRESS -> commit); the spec defines a FastAPI/Postgres/Redis backend with strict security/privacy rules (11_SECURITY_PRIVACY.md).
decisions.reason: Scan rejects it (project type unknown: no code yet), but 02_ARCHITECTURE.md declares a FastAPI backend service. Its dimensions (security, data integrity, traffic readiness, API contract, clarity) match; money/transactions is irrelevant. On-demand, low risk, no permissions. Needs --request.
Generic alternative to forge.agent.backend-reviewer with shell access (risk medium). Installing both would duplicate review; choose one.

No CLAUDE.md exists, and AGENTS.md sits under code-quality-specs/, so Claude Code auto-loads no project instructions. This would create a CLAUDE.md section (~45 lines always-on). Overlap: AGENTS.md already says 'Không tự thêm tính năng ngoài spec'.

Gap: version-specific APIs (Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2, FastAPI). Cost: an MCP server with network access; the project forbids sending source code to external LLMs in some modes (doc lookups send library names, not code).
Only discoverability of managed files; with one managed skill it adds little. Shared-file edit, so it is the user's call.
